contextBudgetTokens.description: Overrides app.contextBudgetTokens for this agent. Absent means the app-wide value.

expertise.description: What this agent should be contacted about, in a few words. Shown to every other agent so they know when to hand work over.

mailbox.description: The one email address this agent acts as. Absent means the agent has no mail capability, and a deployment with no mailbox anywhere runs exactly as it does today.

announcementChannelId.description: Channel where arriving mail is announced. Must not be a DM, and the agent must be a member — both refused at boot rather than discovered at runtime.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often the mailbox is polled for new arrivals, each poll advancing the durable cursor. Announcement latency is bounded by this plus idle-gating.

address.description: The mailbox address this agent acts as. Fixed here and never model-supplied: the from on everything the agent sends.

clientId.description: Client id of this agent's Entra app registration. One registration per agent mailbox — scoped by Exchange App RBAC — so the provider itself enforces that an agent reaches no mailbox but its own.

clientSecret.description: Client secret of the app registration. It expires on a tenant schedule, and mail stops when it does.

tenantId.description: Entra tenant id the mailbox lives in

address.description: The mailbox address this agent acts as. Fixed here and never model-supplied: the from on everything the agent sends.

secure.description: true for implicit TLS from the first byte (typically ports 993/465); false to connect plain and upgrade via STARTTLS where the server offers it (typically ports 143/587)

imap.description: The IMAP endpoint mail is read from

secure.description: true for implicit TLS from the first byte (typically ports 993/465); false to connect plain and upgrade via STARTTLS where the server offers it (typically ports 143/587)

smtp.description: The SMTP endpoint mail is sent through

username.description: Login username for both endpoints, where it differs from the address

provider.description: Which kind of provider serves this mailbox, with its credentials: Exchange Online, or generic IMAP/SMTP.

memoryCaps.description: Per-field overrides of app.memoryCaps for this agent. Unnamed fields keep the app-wide value.

maxBodyChars.description: Longest body one entry may hold. A longer write is refused rather than truncated.

maxDescriptionChars.description: Longest description one entry may hold. Descriptions enter the system prompt every turn, so this bounds that cost.

maxEntries.description: How many entries one agent may hold. Writing beyond it evicts the oldest entry.

model.description: LLM model and provider for this agent

skills.description: Names of the skills this agent is assigned: framework skills by bare name, plugin skills by their qualified "<plugin>__<skill>" name

tools.description: Names of the tools this agent may call: framework tools by bare name, plugin tools by their qualified "<plugin>__<tool>" name

username.description: The agent's unique identity (a lowercase slug) — must equal the username of its Mattermost bot account

contextBudgetTokens.description: How many estimated tokens of channel history one turn may assemble (§3.8), overridable per agent. The estimate is a character ratio, not a tokenizer.

debounce.description: How message fragments are folded into one turn (§4.4)

ceilingMs.description: Hard limit on how long folding may delay a turn, so a human typing steadily still gets a response

windowMs.description: How long to wait after each message before starting a turn, folding fragments into one turn for free (§4.4). Past this the running turn folds them instead, at the cost of a discarded completion. Keep it well under 5s: it is also how long the typing indicator must cover before the turn lights its own.

inferenceRetry.description: How transport failures from a model provider are retried. Semantic failures are never retried.

backoffMs.description: Delay before the first retry of a transport failure, doubling with each further attempt

maxAttempts.description: Total attempts allowed for one completion, the first attempt included

inferenceTimeoutMs.description: How long one completion attempt may run before it is aborted and classified as a retryable transport failure. Bounds a provider that accepts the connection and never responds.

memoryCaps.description: The default bounds on every agent’s memory, overridable per agent

maxBodyChars.description: Longest body one entry may hold. A longer write is refused rather than truncated.

maxDescriptionChars.description: Longest description one entry may hold. Descriptions enter the system prompt every turn, so this bounds that cost.

maxEntries.description: How many entries one agent may hold. Writing beyond it evicts the oldest entry.

timezone.description: The timezone to use when displaying dates

turnCeilingPerHour.description: Framework-wide ceiling on turns started per rolling hour. A breach halts every agent until a human posts /resume (§7.4).

channels.description: Per-channel triggering mode. Any channel not listed here is mention-required.

triggerMode.description: mention-required: the agent acts only when explicitly @-mentioned. respond-to-all: every human post starts a turn, and the channel may hold at most one agent (§3.10).

mainChannelId.description: ID of the main channel: where the orchestrator posts its status, and the one channel in which agents answer only when explicitly @-mentioned. Every bot must be a member.

systemBotToken.description: Mattermost token for the orchestrator's own bot account, which posts status notices and owns the slash-command surface. Not an agent, and separate from every agent's bot token. The account must hold authority to manage the team's slash commands (manage_slash_commands, e.g. team admin); boot refuses without it (§8.4).

url.description: Base URL of the Mattermost server (e.g. https://mattermost.example.com)

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the DeepSeek-compatible API
Base URL of the OpenRouter-compatible API

name.description: The plugin's identity: it qualifies the plugin's tools and skills ("<name>__<capability>") and scopes its stored records. Must equal the name the plugin's own manifest declares.

path.description: Path to the plugin's package root, resolved relative to config.json

settings.description: This plugin's settings, validated against the schema the plugin declares
